items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Last night I was with him until 2 this morning – Luis Moreno... He’s a great guy... Luis is one of the best guys in the world... After that thing, he wants me to go to 13 of them with him

ctx.x: David Baker, however you do it, try to find a way to get down there February 2nd. You have never experienced anything like that in your life, like the carnival. I promise

you, you will have goose bumps the time you get off the plane until the time you leave. Total Angolan influence and the merger of the most powerful African culture and lyricism of Portuguese and African, like you’d never heard in your life, and it never stops. It will make beehives grow on your booty. I’m telling you. Nobody – you can’t – you won’t believe it. I go every year, and I’m blown away after seeing it 54 years. Don’t – let’s not talk – but they know how to do it all, from cachaza, [?katarenyo] – that’s…
